notes.title: Customize Your Challenge – Update Live!
notes.notes:
Difficulty Update Available Now!
Some players said the game was too easy. Others said it was too hard. And many asked for more creative ways to play. So I listened - and this free content update is for all of you. With new difficulty settings and optional gameplay modifiers, you can now tailor the experience exactly how you want it. 👽


 🔧Difficulty Selection
You can now choose between Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties when starting a game. Whether you're here for the story or a brutal challenge, there's a mode for you.


 💀Custom Difficulty Modifiers
Looking for a truly custom experience? Activate one or more Difficulty Modifiers to spice things up. Inspired by the Skull system in Halo, these optional tweaks dramatically change the way the game plays. You can unlock them by finding Dr Antonius' Research Logs!

Here's what you can enable:

One Vision - Attaches a camera to the Survivor. All other cameras are disabled.

Finishing The Fight - John brings a gun instead of a flashlight.

Blind And Deaf - The Monster makes no sound when moving or breathing. Survivor icon is removed from the minimap.

Out of Time - Minigames no longer pause the game. Think fast.

Never Safe - All hiding spots are removed from the map.

Unlimited Power - Cameras & ship navigation systems are always online, no batteries required.

Speed - Survivor AND Monster movement speeds are increased by 50%. 

Mix and match to create your perfect nightmare.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/35e6b0033da831d67843dac4b4926f700c20e66b.png"]
[hr][/hr] 🐞Bug Fixes & Improvements
This update also includes several bug fixes and quality-of-life tweaks:

fixed a potential issue where the victory screen didn't show up in the prologue and Engineering Bay levels

added a checkpoint in the Spacewalk level after turning on the engines.

 the monster now starts patrolling from the same point each level

 the monster will now properly go to alarm location upon triggering it

QTE ui animation changed to not be misleading

 symbols can now be pressed directly on their icon in addition to their corresponding button in the symbols minigame 

 hair is now visible on the player shadow

increased spacewalk movement speed by 50% and jump height slightly

 added an option to skip the bridge sequence in the final boss level

 clamped FOV slider to 70110 to prevent disjointed arm

fixed a bug where players would stay connected after the end credits rolled





Thank you for playing, and we can't wait to see the challenges you create using the new modifiers. If you survive, let us know how you did. 

Tyci

notes.title: Out Now! Astrumis – Survive Together, My Debut Solo-Dev Release
notes.notes:
SURVIVAL IS NO LONGER A DRILL! ‘ASTRUMIS - SURVIVE TOGETHER’ NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM

Hey everyone — I’m incredibly excited (and still kind of in disbelief) to finally announce that my first game, Astrumis – Survive Together, is now available on Steam!

This has been a solo project from start to finish — a true passion project. Inspired by some of my favorite sci-fi and horror experiences, I set out to create a co-op game that really leans hard into teamwork, communication, and suspense. Whether you’re guiding your partner from mission control or sneaking through dark corridors yourself, survival depends on how well you work together.

👉 To celebrate the launch, there's a brand-new trailer showcasing the game!
[previewyoutube=7whaSk8bGbg;full][/previewyoutube]

Game Features:
✔️ 100% co-op experience with two distinct gameplay roles
✔️ Friend Pass – one copy is all you need to play together
✔️ Survivor: Real-time action and hacking as John Kowalski
✔️ Mission Control: Strategic puzzles and navigation as Yang Sungbin
✔️ 9 story-driven levels with full voice acting and cinematic storytelling
✔️ A tense, story-rich sci-fi setting with secrets to uncover and systems to survive
✔️ Ongoing post-launch support with updates, new features, and expanded content

🖼️Some brand-new screenshots showcasing the gameplay:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/d8975791764a84846f9f96d39244f95c110f7783.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/c7b77d009c6a6f9b952f025340132979f6ced299.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176852/20ba4c915257f87a5239fe6f768a9fa681d20a21.png


This isn’t the end — not even close. I’m committed to supporting Astrumis post-launch with ongoing updates. That means bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and new free content down the line. I’m already working on new game modes and even additional story content. Your feedback is everything, so if you're playing, please share your thoughts — they’ll help shape what comes next.

You can grab Astrumis – Survive Together now on Steam. And if you want to share feedback, report bugs, or just talk about the game, join the community over on the Discord!

Thanks so much for supporting this wild solo dev journey.
– Tyci

notes.title: Optimization Update 1.05 - Graphics & Network Optimized + Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🫡
Many people had issues with performance and lags even on powerful machines, so I decided that the next priority was optimization. The most important thing was the GPU - there were far too many super-high quality assets & textures, so I reduced their resolution. It's barely noticable to the player but improves the performance a lot. Many high requested bugfixes appear in this patch as well - full list down below 👇.

General:

 Achieved a stable 60 FPS on recommended settings.
 Network optimization - reduced network lag.
 

New:

 Speed lines vfx added while flying the ship in the Interlude level
 Logo font implemented in some places for a cleaner look


Fixes:

 Proper usernames appear during character select for both players
 Visual bug where John's body parts were not in sync while moving
 Opening the in-game Pause menu will no longer hide the mouse for some players
 Fixed a bug making players stay connected after credits rolled
 increased asteroid spawnrate during Interlude level
 John and Yang running speed during Prologue intro cinematic improved
 Flying corpse during Prologue intro cinematic will no longer clip through window
 Computer screen no longer clips through monitor stand in the Prologue
 Monster will no longer move while eating the player during the Prologue level

notes.title: Patch 1.04 - New Features & Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey!
Thanks so much to everybody who played during Steam Next Fest (or after)! I recieved a lot of feedback from you, so this patch is to address those issues!

New features:

 Skipping cutscenes is now possible! Requires confirmation from both players. ːsteamhappyː  At first I was hesitant to add this since I worked hard on the curtscenes, but after hearing player feedback that this hurts replayability I decided to add it!
 Streamer mode added. Some streamers/youtubers have recieved copyright strikes, so this mode will mute licensed music.
 Added a tutorial notification about using the number keys to switch cameras as Mission Control during the Prologue level
 Added camera shake effect when boosting the spaceship


Bugs fixed:

 It's no longer possible to go back inside the ship from the beginning of the Spacewalk level.
 Fixed an issue where sometimes it was not possible to finish the demo after going back inside the ship
 Monster will now properly stop in the corridor during the Prologue
 Closing the ingame pause menu will no longer hide the cursor for Mission Control
 Entering a minigame in the exact moment of a footstep will no longer spam footstep SFX
 You can zoom in further when controlling the spaceship
 Resolution scaling will now properly load the saved selected setting
